title.narrative: Peace Building and Community Dialogues in Syria

description.narrative: Additionally disbursed funding for NPA’s humanitarian response in Syria enable an integrated mine action and recovery programme that strengthens community safety, resilience, and inclusive governance. The support allows NPA to operate across key regions of the country, tailoring interventions to levels of contamination, accessibility, local needs (assessments including gender-, age-, and disabilities), and available capacities. The programme focuses on protecting communities from explosive hazards, improving livelihoods and economic recovery, and supporting community-driven dialogue and cooperation. Activities include baseline surveys to map contamination and prioritise response, explosive ordnance disposal to remove immediate threats, and culturally adapted risk education that reaches schools, community centres, and local networks. Peacebuilding efforts foster dialogue, reduce tensions, and empower local mediators while encouraging cooperation in shared mine action and recovery initiatives. By integrating technical mine action with community engagement and resilience work, the programme creates strong synergies that reduce risk, protect the environment, build trust, and support safer, more sustainable post-conflict recovery across affected areas.
